>>315600407
>The Industrial Revolution and its consequences have been a disaster for the human race.
Not exactly. I agree with the overall premise, but reliance on technology and laziness do more to screw us over than anything else. The industrial revolution created men of iron that worked the steel which runs the world. They were productive, not lazy. Producing a "better future" for your children requies you also form and shape them to your image, by teaching them all the things, but even that isn't a guarantee. Your children can completely ignore you and do their own thing and become what you hate, despite your best efforts.
